compensated.description: names of the compensated steps (written by the execution)

completed.description: names of the completed steps (written by the execution)

current.description: {step, attempt, phase} of the step in progress, with started_at when the step declares a timeout (written by the execution)

error.description: the failed step and error code (written by the execution)

max_attempts.description: attempts per step under forward recovery (default 1)

operators.description: principals who may retry, skip or cancel (since 1.0-rc12)

skipped.description: {step, principal, reason} of the skipped steps (written by the execution, since 1.0-rc12)

status.description: pending | running | stuck | compensating | completed | compensated | failed (written by the execution; stuck since 1.0-rc12)

steps.description: {name, process, compensation, timeout, on_timeout} items; process and compensation are {target, port, params}; timeout is a duration and on_timeout recover | escalate (since 1.0-rc12)
